emails.subject: Receipt for household marine supplies
emails.body: Thank you for shopping at Sausalito Marine Supply on January 5. Items: biodegradable all-purpose cleaner, nitrile gloves, and two soft scrub pads. Paid in full at the counter; no items are on backorder.

emails.subject: Recycling-room cardboard sweep completed
emails.body: The resident recycling-room cardboard sweep scheduled for January 9 has been completed. Oversize flattened boxes left before noon were moved to the municipal pickup stack. No resident follow-up is needed.
